A Daze to Remember | WaterColor, Florida

614 E Royal Fern Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

True to its name, A Daze to Remember | 614 E Royal Fern Way was designed for unforgettable vacations with family and friends. Nestled within the WaterColor community in the Crossings District, this luxury vacation rental retreat combines elegant coastal design, spacious accommodations, and exceptional outdoor living to create the perfect setting for your next 30A getaway.

Accommodating up to 12 guests, the home features five bedrooms, a custom bunk room, and a private carriage house. Three king suites offer peaceful retreats after a day at the beach, while thoughtfully designed common areas invite everyone to come together and make lasting memories.

Step outside to discover one of the home's most desirable features: a private backyard oasis complete with a sparkling pool and multiple porches designed for relaxation. Enjoy your morning coffee surrounded by the quiet beauty of WaterColor, spend the afternoon poolside with the family, and unwind in the evening with a glass of wine as the coastal breeze drifts through the trees.

The private carriage house provides additional privacy and flexibility, making it ideal for guests who appreciate their own space while remaining connected to the rest of the group.

Located within WaterColor, guests enjoy easy access to the community's celebrated amenities, scenic trails, resort-style pools, beach access, parks, and nearby dining and shopping along 30A.

- Comfortable living room with plush seating

- Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and barstool seating for three guests

- Stylish dining room table with seating for 8 guests

- Covered porch with seating and direct views of the pool and nature preserve

- Master bedroom with king size bed, private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub

- Laundry room

Second Floor

- Landing space with seating and a tv

- Guest bedroom with a king size bed, access to the front balcony, and private bathroom

- Guest bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom

- Bunk space with one twin over twin bunk and small desk

- Guest bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom

Carriage House

- Cozy living room with seating and a tv

- Kitchenette with small stovetop burner, microwave, dishwash, and small beverage fridge

- Guest bedroom with a queen size bed and private bathroom

Outdoor Space

- Seating for relaxing

- Dining table with seating six guests

- Grill

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 12 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
